say:2:1630158001:1.text: Death? Is that what this looks like to you?
say:2:1630158001:1.source_cn: 死亡……在你看来，我也陷入了死亡吗？
say:2:1630158001:1.male: Death? Is that what this looks like to you?
say:2:1630158001:1.female: Death? Is that what this looks like to you?

say:3:1630158002:1.text: For all you know, my soul is out galloping across time—next week, last century, take your pick.
say:3:1630158002:1.source_cn: 说不定此刻我的灵魂已经去往了未来，或是过去……
say:3:1630158002:1.male: For all you know, my soul is out galloping across time—next week, last century, take your pick.
say:3:1630158002:1.female: For all you know, my soul is out galloping across time—next week, last century, take your pick.

say:4:1630158003:1.text: But hush. Time-meddling magic is forbidden. It goes to the grave with me.
say:4:1630158003:1.source_cn: 嘘——不要告诉别人。这种隐秘的魔法必须随我入土。
say:4:1630158003:1.male: But hush. Time-meddling magic is forbidden. It goes to the grave with me.
say:4:1630158003:1.female: But hush. Time-meddling magic is forbidden. It goes to the grave with me.

say:5:1630158004:1.text: With that magic, I will surpass even the great Professor Dorphis! I will be... unstoppable! Hahahahaha!
say:5:1630158004:1.source_cn: 这个魔法……这个魔法能让我超越！甚至超越我敬爱的朵尔斐...
say:5:1630158004:1.male: With that magic, I will surpass even the great Professor Dorphis! I will be... unstoppable! Hahahahaha!
say:5:1630158004:1.female: With that magic, I will surpass even the great Professor Dorphis! I will be... unstoppable! Hahahahaha!
